review_kind: Eight complete pinned AWS/Azure cloud-operations packages; individual source-vetting grades, NOT governed semantic reviews
macro_findings: All eight are first-class exact-pinned packages; 15 package-owned files including seven required references were read; package trees match pinned manifest.

Cross-provider shared defect: cloud account, cost, production logs, credentials, DNS/network, registry lifecycle or GitHub issue writes are initiated without complete action-specific authority. GitHub issue confirmation in two cost workflows does not authorize preceding cloud reads.

The Azure Container Registry references include credential-bearing CLI patterns, destructive purge, RBAC, persistent tasks and network bypass. Azure deployment preflight overstates that a what-if pass means deployment is safe/authorized.
AWS CloudWatch query templates retain reference value but do not grant production telemetry read rights; fixed account-concurrency and metric assumptions need validation.
Seven reject unchanged and one reference-only; no governed admission, package security scan, behavioral test, or deduplicated eligible denominator claim.
